summary: TypeScript client SDK for SOX Protocol v1. Mirrors the Python SDK shape (low-level client + high-level helpers) but is HTTP-transport-only for the initial cut: it speaks the OpenAPI surface in spec/transports/http/openapi.yaml. Codegen converts spec/operations/*.json + spec/envelopes/*.json (JSON Schema draft-07) into strict TS types under src/generated/. Public API exposes one method per v1 MUST operation (14 methods: send, recv, subscribe, unsubscribe, list_channels, channels__ack, channels__heartbeat, replay, group_create, group_invite, group_join, group_leave, group_list_members, list_agents) plus the planned channels__collect (gated behind a runtime capability flag). Helpers layer adds askAndWait (correlation_id round-trip), reply (envelope-aware send with reply_to), drain (recv-until-empty with backpressure-aware pacing), and bootstrap (the SHOULD sequence: list_channels -> subscribe -> list_agents -> recv). Dual ESM/CJS build targets Node 20+ and modern browsers; uses native fetch + native EventSource where available with eventsource shim fallback. Strict TS, 100% coverage, no any outside generated code, npm-publishable as @sox-protocol/client.

codegen.approach: Read each JSON Schema, map draft-07 constructs (type, enum, oneOf, additionalProperties:false, required[], minLength, format) to strict TS interfaces and string-literal unions. One .ts file per operation (e.g. send.ts -> SendInput, SendOutput) and one per envelope. Emit src/generated/index.ts barrel + src/generated/operations.ts (OperationName -> {Input,Output} map keyed for client typing). Codegen also emits src/generated/schemas.ts containing the raw JSON Schema objects so ajv can validate at runtime in dev/test. Tool is invoked via `pnpm codegen` (script alias for `tsx tools/ts_codegen.ts`). Deterministic output (alphabetical keys, sorted unions); regenerated output must be byte-identical so CI can fail on drift.

files.purpose: Codegen script: reads JSON Schemas from spec/operations/*.json and spec/envelopes/*.json, emits strict TS interfaces, string-literal unions for enums, and a runtime schemas map for ajv validation. Deterministic, idempotent.

npm package manifest. name=@sox-protocol/client, type=module, exports map for ESM/CJS/types, scripts: build, codegen, test, test:coverage, lint, typecheck, pack:dry. Declares dependencies (ajv, eventsource) and peerDependencies as needed.

tsc --strict config. target=ES2022, module=ESNext, moduleResolution=bundler, strict=true, noUncheckedIndexedAccess=true, exactOptionalPropertyTypes=true, declaration=true, declarationMap=true. Excludes tests from the build output.
Secondary tsc config for CJS build output (module=CommonJS, outDir=dist/cjs). Extends tsconfig.json.

tsup bundler config — produces dist/index.js (ESM), dist/index.cjs (CJS), dist/index.d.ts. Sourcemaps on, treeshake on, target=es2022 + node20 + browsers (es2020 fallback). Sets up bundle size budget reporter (<= 50KB minified).

vitest config with @vitest/coverage-v8, thresholds: lines/functions/branches/statements=100, environment=node, also runs jsdom-environment tests for browser EventSource path. Excludes src/generated/** from coverage requirement (codegen output).
eslint config. Extends @typescript-eslint/recommended-type-checked + strict; bans any (no-explicit-any: error, no-unsafe-*); allows generated/** to be ignored. max-warnings=0 enforced via CLI.
Ignore dist/, node_modules/, coverage/. src/generated/ is linted but exempt from no-explicit-any if codegen produces unavoidable widening.
Exclude src/, tests/, tsconfig*, vitest.config.ts, .eslintrc, coverage/ from published tarball. Keep only dist/, README.md, LICENSE, package.json.
Package README — install, quickstart (low-level client + bootstrap helper), link to spec/protocol.md, conformance notes, browser vs node usage.
Apache-2.0 license text matching the repo root LICENSE.
Barrel re-export. Exports: SoxClient, SoxClientConfig, all helpers (askAndWait, reply, drain, bootstrap), all generated Input/Output types, envelope types, and the SoxError class.

Low-level SoxClient class. One method per v1 MUST operation, plus channels__collect (planned). Each method takes a typed Input and resolves to a typed Output, throws SoxError on non-2xx. Constructor accepts SoxClientConfig {baseUrl, agentId, fetch?, eventSource?, headers?, timeoutMs?}. Internal _request() centralizes JSON marshalling, error envelope decoding, and (in dev mode) ajv validation of inputs/outputs against the embedded schemas.

SoxError class extending Error. Fields: errorCode, message, detail, retryAfter, httpStatus. Static fromEnvelope(envelope, status) constructor parses sox-error.schema.json shape from a non-2xx response.

Internal HTTP transport. Wraps fetch with: AbortController-based timeouts, JSON body encoding, X-Agent-Id header injection, retry-after handling, and SoxError envelope decoding. Pure function module — no class, no state — so the SoxClient can be constructed with an injected fetch impl for testing.

Optional SSE/EventSource adapter for live recv streaming. Uses globalThis.EventSource when available, falls back to the eventsource npm package in Node. Yields decoded envelopes as an AsyncIterable. Used by the drain() helper when config.streaming=true.
public_api: function openRecvStream(config: SoxClientConfig, input: RecvInput): AsyncIterable<MessageEnvelope>

files.purpose: High-level helpers built on SoxClient. askAndWait sends a message with a fresh correlation_id and polls recv until a matching reply arrives or timeout. reply is a thin send wrapper that copies channel + sets reply_to/correlation_id from a parent envelope. drain repeatedly calls recv until empty (or a max-batches cap) honoring backpressure hints. bootstrap performs the SHOULD sequence: list_channels (version check) -> subscribe (patterns) -> list_agents (optional) -> first recv. All helpers accept a SoxClient instance — no hidden state.
public_api: reply(client: SoxClient, parent: MessageEnvelope, body: unknown): Promise<SendOutput>

files.purpose: Hand-written envelope types (MessageEnvelope, MessageMeta) that the codegen-generated operation types reference. Keeps the canonical envelope shape stable even if individual operation schemas change.

Codegen output directory. Contents: one .ts per operation (send.ts, recv.ts, subscribe.ts, unsubscribe.ts, list_channels.ts, channels_ack.ts, channels_heartbeat.ts, replay.ts, channels_collect.ts, group_create.ts, group_invite.ts, group_join.ts, group_leave.ts, group_list_members.ts, list_agents.ts), one per envelope (sox_invite.ts, sox_ack.ts, sox_nack.ts, sox_error.ts), an operations.ts type-map, a schemas.ts runtime-schema map, and an index.ts barrel. Regenerated by `pnpm codegen`; tracked in git for reproducibility; CI fails on drift.

Unit tests for SoxClient. Mocks fetch via vi.fn(); asserts correct URL/method/body/headers per operation, error envelope decoding, timeout behavior, and that all 14 v1 MUST operations + channels__collect have a method that round-trips a happy-path payload.

Unit tests for askAndWait, reply, drain, bootstrap. Uses an in-memory fake SoxClient implementing the same interface. Covers correlation_id matching, timeout, drain pagination/backpressure, bootstrap sequence ordering.

Snapshot/golden test for tools/ts_codegen.ts. Runs the codegen tool against spec/operations + spec/envelopes and asserts the output is byte-identical to the committed src/generated/ tree (drift detector).
Unit tests for the HTTP transport: header injection, timeout via AbortController, error envelope decoding, retry-after parsing.
Unit tests for the SSE adapter using a fake EventSource constructor. Asserts AsyncIterable yields, error propagation, and clean close on consumer break.

Integration tests against a live Python HTTP transport (spawned via child_process from packages/python). Skipped when SOX_INTEGRATION!=1 in CI matrix. Covers: bootstrap, send->recv round-trip, subscribe glob, replay cursor, group lifecycle (create/invite/join/list_members/leave), ack/nack, heartbeat, list_agents.
Runs the spec/conformance harness against this SDK. Loads conformance fixtures, executes the documented scenarios via SoxClient, asserts wire conformance.

risks: JSON Schema -> TS mapping fidelity: oneOf/anyOf and integer-vs-number nullability nuances can produce loose types if codegen is naive; mitigation: golden tests + drift detector
Bundle size: ajv runtime is ~30KB; mitigation: tree-shake ajv to validation-only path, or make runtime validation a dev-only opt-in
EventSource browser/node parity: native EventSource exists in browsers and Node >= 18 (experimental); mitigation: feature-detect + fall back to eventsource npm shim
ESM/CJS dual-build hazards (named exports, type resolution): mitigation: tsup + explicit exports map in package.json, tested via pack:dry
100% coverage requirement on async streaming code (SSE) is brittle; mitigation: inject a fake EventSource in tests rather than mocking globals
Codegen drift between contributors (different node versions, locales): mitigation: pin codegen tool to tsx + Node 20, sort all keys/unions alphabetically, commit generated/
